subject: Stakeholder canvas + MAP seed for Catalyst pilot
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Amy Choi <amy.choi@catalyst.ai>, LynxCorp Procurement <procurement@lynxcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial MAP canvas + seed doc for Catalyst pilot

Hi Amy,

Thanks for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass MAP canvas (GDoc) and a 6-slide kickoff deck (GSlides) meant to accelerate the pilot evaluation. The doc is intentionally compact — the areas I'd like feedback on are: success criteria, owner lanes, and the acceptance checklist.

Proposed next steps:
- Share feedback on the GDoc by EOD Monday (11/15)
- Kickoff workshop (45m) to align stakeholders and confirm telemetry by Wed 11/17
- Target pilot window: 30 days, with a decision checkpoint at day 21

Attachments (stubs): MAP_seed_template_v1.gdoc, MAP_kickoff_slides_v1.gslides
Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A_MAP_SEED_LINK
Google Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1A_MAP_SLIDES_LINK

Can you confirm who from your side will own success criteria and whether procurement needs an SOW before the kickoff?

Thanks,

Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Amy Choi <amy.choi@catalyst.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: LynxCorp Procurement <procurement@lynxcorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP canvas + seed doc for Catalyst pilot

Thanks Mateo — this is helpful.

Quick notes from our side:
- Procurement asks for an estimated SOW + rough cost outline before we schedule the kickoff.
- We'd prefer a 21-day pilot (tighter internal window) with an internal demo on day 14.
- I'll own success criteria but will delegate technical validations to my lead engineer (CC'd when we confirm a date).

Can you send a one-pager SOW stub and a short cost estimate? If you can pivot the MAP to a 21-day sprint with explicit day-by-day milestones that would help.

Best,

Amy Choi
Head of Product, Catalyst AI
amy.choi@catalyst.ai
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Amy Choi <amy.choi@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T11:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP canvas + seed doc for Catalyst pilot

Amy — thanks for the quick turnaround. We're happy to compress to 21 days.

I've created an updated MAP (link below) that replaces the 30-day window with a 21-day sprint and a day-by-day milestone table. High-level changes:
- Day 0-2: infra tokens & test dataset upload; access validation
- Day 3-7: integration + baseline metric collection
- Day 8-13: iterative tuning and quality validation
- Day 14: internal demo for Catalyst (as requested)
- Day 15-21: acceptance testing & final decision checkpoint

I've also attached a one-page SOW stub and a concise cost estimate (attachment stub): pilot_success_criteria.xlsx, SOW_stub_onepager.pdf
Updated MAP GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A_MAP_SEED_LINK_v2

Proposed kickoff: Thursday 11/17 at 10:00 AM PT — does that work for you? We'll prepare a 30-45m agenda focused on roles, telemetry, and acceptance gates. Marissa will draft the SOW and Jasmine will own the slide deck.

On procurement: Marissa — can you draft a short SOW + ballpark cost by EOD tomorrow so Amy can share with procurement?

Thanks,

Mateo
